name: Dream Hacker -Musouban-
source:
It seems there's a way to control dreams.
You create the image in your head of the dream you want to dream beforehand, but the details are unknown.

You would be free to change what happens in the dream to whatever you would like and it would feel just like it was the real thing, or maybe even better.

That's right, it's a dream so you can do whatever you want.
You can totally let your desires run wild. 

[Taken from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041681.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
似乎存在一種控制夢境的方法。
事先在腦中勾勒出自己想做的夢，具體原理卻無人知曉。

你可以隨心所欲地改變夢中發生的一切，感受就像真實體驗一樣，甚至可能比現實更加美妙。

沒錯，既然是夢，就能做任何想做的事情。
你完全可以任由慾望奔馳。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041681.html]English DLsite[/url]]
